text: ４のしまに　かえって　くると　ぬいぐるみが　ふえていくの！

structure.jp: ４のしまに　かえって　くると
structure.en: whenever she comes back to Four Island

structure.jp: ぬいぐるみが　ふえていくの！

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb means 'whenever' that happens, the next thing follows. かえって　くると = 'whenever one comes back'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb shows a change that keeps going on from now. ふえていく = 'keep increasing'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb shows movement toward where the speaker is. かえって　くる = 'come back here'.
